title: "3_gompertz_loess_models"
output: html_document
params:
  run_mammals: true
  run_birds: true
  write_models: true
  loess_span: 0.75
  loess_z: 1.96
  mammals_points: "Data/Results/persist_points_mammals.csv"
  birds_points: "Data/Results/persist_points_birds.csv"
  loess_models_rds: "Data/Clean/gompertz_loess_models.rds"

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Fit shifted-Gompertz curves and body-mass interpolation models.
source("R/project_utils.R")
source("R/figure_utils.R")
source("R/gompertz_config.R")

RUN_MAMMALS <- isTRUE(params$run_mammals)
RUN_BIRDS <- isTRUE(params$run_birds)
WRITE_MODELS <- isTRUE(params$write_models)
CURVES <- gompertz_curves()
K0 <- quasi_extinction_abundance()
SPAN_LOESS <- as.numeric(params$loess_span)
Z_LOESS <- as.numeric(params$loess_z)
PATHS <- list(
  mammals_points = params$mammals_points,
  birds_points = params$birds_points,
  loess_models_rds = params$loess_models_rds,
  bird_ilr_coords = params$bird_ilr_coords,
  bird_sigma_draws = params$bird_sigma_draws
)

load_gompertz_packages()
source("R/gompertz_core.R")
source("R/gompertz_figures.R")

validate_gompertz_config(params, CURVES, SPAN_LOESS, Z_LOESS)
check_gompertz_inputs(PATHS, RUN_MAMMALS, RUN_BIRDS, WRITE_MODELS)
```

```{r fit_models}
curves <- load_all_persistence_points(PATHS, RUN_MAMMALS, RUN_BIRDS, CURVES, K0)
validate_bird_combo_coverage(curves, PATHS, RUN_BIRDS)
gomp_params <- fit_all_gompertz_parameters(curves, K0)

if (any(!gomp_params$fit_ok)) {
  warning("Some shifted-Gompertz fits failed; failed rows are retained with NA parameters.")
}

built_loess <- build_gompertz_loess_models(
  gomp_params = gomp_params,
  paths = PATHS,
  run_mammals = RUN_MAMMALS,
  run_birds = RUN_BIRDS,
  curves = CURVES,
  span = SPAN_LOESS,
  z = Z_LOESS,
  k0 = K0
)
loess_models <- built_loess$models
loess_pred <- built_loess$prediction_grid
pm_mammals <- gomp_params |> dplyr::filter(group == "Mammals", fit_ok)
pm_birds <- gomp_params |> dplyr::filter(group == "Birds", fit_ok)

if (WRITE_MODELS) {
  saveRDS(loess_models, PATHS$loess_models_rds)
  message("Wrote: ", PATHS$loess_models_rds)
}

message(
  "Model fitting complete | persistence rows=", nrow(curves),
  " | Gompertz fits=", nrow(gomp_params),
  " | failed=", sum(!gomp_params$fit_ok),
  " | LOESS prediction rows=", nrow(loess_pred)
)
```

```{r}
## ---- fig3_mammals_wolff_vs_shifted_gompertz --------------------------------
## Figure 3 (printed only; NO files written):
## Simulated persistence points vs
##   (i) shifted Gompertz fit (K0 fixed)
##   (ii) Wolff specification (A fixed; c fit per panel)
##
## Panel (c) x-axis breaks forced to: 500, 1000, 2000, 4000.

# ---------------------------- figure-specific knobs ---------------------------
curve_use <- "q50"
mass_idxs <- c(1L, 16L, 31L)
A_WOLFF   <- 10

KEY_GOMP  <- "Shifted Gompertz fit"
KEY_WOLFF <- "Wolff specification"
KEY_PTS   <- "Simulated points"

col_gomp  <- "#0072B2"
col_wolff <- "grey30"
col_pts   <- "grey78"
col_k0    <- "grey82"

pt_alpha  <- 0.90
pt_size   <- 1.8

lwd_gomp  <- 1.15
lwd_wolff <- 0.80
lty_wolff <- "22"
lwd_k0    <- 0.45
lty_k0    <- "dotted"

# ---------------------------- data: points + fitted parameters ----------------
df <- curves |>
  dplyr::filter(group == "Mammals", curve == curve_use, mass_idx %in% mass_idxs) |>
  dplyr::select(group, mass_idx, mass_g, curve, K, p_eval) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    gomp_params |>
      dplyr::filter(group == "Mammals", curve == curve_use, mass_idx %in% mass_idxs, fit_ok) |>
      dplyr::select(group, mass_idx, mass_g, curve, alpha, beta),
    by = c("group", "mass_idx", "mass_g", "curve")
  )

series_levels <- c(KEY_GOMP, KEY_WOLFF, KEY_PTS)
series_cols   <- stats::setNames(c(col_gomp, col_wolff, col_pts), series_levels)

# ---------------------------- panel builder -----------------------------------
make_panel <- function(midx, show_y = TRUE, show_legend = FALSE) {
  dfi <- df |>
    dplyr::filter(mass_idx == midx)

  mass_g <- dfi$mass_g[1]
  alpha  <- dfi$alpha[1]
  beta   <- dfi$beta[1]

  c_hat <- fit_wolff_c_nls(dfi$K, dfi$p_eval, A = A_WOLFF)

  K_max <- max(dfi$K, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Left x-limit used in the plot so the Wolff curve reaches the panel boundary.
  logK0      <- log10(K0)
  logKmax    <- log10(K_max)
  K_left_plot <- 10^(logK0 - 0.03 * (logKmax - logK0))

  # Separate grids so the shifted Gompertz still begins just above K0,
  # while the Wolff curve extends to the x-axis minimum.
  K_grid_gomp  <- exp(seq(log(K0 * 1.0005), log(K_max), length.out = 700))
  K_grid_wolff <- exp(seq(log(K_left_plot),  log(K_max), length.out = 800))

  line_gomp <- tibble::tibble(
    K = K_grid_gomp,
    p = predict_p(alpha, beta, K_grid_gomp, K0 = K0),
    Series = KEY_GOMP
  )

  line_wolff <- tibble::tibble(
    K = K_grid_wolff,
    p = p_wolff(K_grid_wolff, c_hat, A = A_WOLFF),
    Series = KEY_WOLFF
  )

  pts_here <- dfi |>
    dplyr::transmute(K = K, p = p_eval, Series = KEY_PTS)

  r2_g <- r2_prob(dfi$p_eval, predict_p(alpha, beta, dfi$K, K0 = K0))
  r2_w <- r2_prob(dfi$p_eval, p_wolff(dfi$K, c_hat, A = A_WOLFF))

  r2_geo <- r2_key_layout(K_left = K_left_plot, K_max = K_max)
  r2_key <- tibble::tibble(
    Series = factor(c(KEY_GOMP, KEY_WOLFF), levels = c(KEY_GOMP, KEY_WOLFF)),
    y      = r2_geo$y_vals,
    label  = formatC(c(r2_g, r2_w), digits = 3, format = "f"),
    x0     = r2_geo$seg_x0,
    x1     = r2_geo$seg_x1,
    x_txt  = r2_geo$num_x
  )

  breaks_x <- NULL
  if (midx == mass_idxs[2]) {
    bx <- c(1000, 3000, 9000)
    breaks_x <- bx[bx >= K_left_plot & bx <= K_max * 1.02]
  } else if (midx == mass_idxs[3]) {
    bx <- c(500, 1000, 2000, 4000)
    breaks_x <- bx[bx >= K_left_plot & bx <= K_max * 1.02]
  }

  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = pts_here,
      ggplot2::aes(x = K, y = p, color = Series),
      alpha = pt_alpha,
      size = pt_size
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = line_gomp,
      ggplot2::aes(x = K, y = p, color = Series),
      linewidth = lwd_gomp,
      lineend = "round",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = line_wolff,
      ggplot2::aes(x = K, y = p, color = Series),
      linewidth = lwd_wolff,
      linetype = lty_wolff,
      lineend = "round",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = K0,
      linewidth  = lwd_k0,
      linetype   = lty_k0,
      color      = col_k0
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = r2_geo$box_x0, xmax = r2_geo$box_x1,
      ymin = r2_geo$box_y0, ymax = r2_geo$box_y1,
      fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.94),
      color = "grey80",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = r2_geo$num_x, y = r2_geo$y_title,
      label = "R\u00b2",
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 3.5,
      color = "grey10"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = r2_key,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x0, xend = x1, y = y, yend = y, color = Series, linetype = Series),
      linewidth = 0.95,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = r2_key,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x_txt, y = y, label = label),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 3.45,
      color = "grey10",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(
      values = stats::setNames(c("solid", lty_wolff), c(KEY_GOMP, KEY_WOLFF)),
      guide  = "none"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_log10(
      limits = c(K_left_plot, K_max),
      breaks = if (is.null(breaks_x)) scales::breaks_log(n = 5) else breaks_x,
      labels = scales::label_comma(),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = series_cols,
      breaks = series_levels,
      name = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        nrow = 1,
        byrow = TRUE,
        keywidth = grid::unit(2.35, "lines"),
        keyheight = grid::unit(0.75, "lines"),
        override.aes = list(
          linetype  = c("solid", lty_wolff, "blank"),
          shape     = c(NA, NA, 16),
          linewidth = c(lwd_gomp, lwd_wolff, 0),
          alpha     = c(1, 1, pt_alpha),
          size      = c(NA, NA, pt_size)
        )
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = fmt_mass_label(mass_g),
      x = "Starting population K",
      y = if (show_y) "Persistence probability" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_pub(base_size = 11.5) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 2)),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "bottom" else "none",
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9.5, color = "grey15", margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 14)),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(2.35, "lines"),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.75, "lines"),
      legend.box.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 2),
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )
}

# ---------------------------- assemble (3 panels + shared legend) -------------
p_leg  <- make_panel(mass_idxs[1], show_y = TRUE,  show_legend = TRUE)
legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p_leg)

p1 <- make_panel(mass_idxs[1], show_y = TRUE,  show_legend = FALSE)
p2 <- make_panel(mass_idxs[2], show_y = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE)
p3 <- make_panel(mass_idxs[3], show_y = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE)

row_panels <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  p1, p2, p3,
  nrow = 1,
  labels = c("(a)", "(b)", "(c)"),
  label_fontface = "bold",
  label_size = 13,
  align = "hv",
  axis = "tb"
)

fig3 <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  row_panels, legend,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.08)
)

fig3
save_manuscript_figure(fig3, "gompertz_wolff")
```


```{r}
## ---- SI_Fig_S3_loess_gomp_params_alpha_beta_two_versions --------------------------
## SI Fig S3 (printed only; NO files written):
## LOESS-derived parameter curves (alpha, beta) for Mammals.
## Produces TWO versions:
##   (A) Median persistence only (q50)
##   (B) Median + lower-tail persistence (q50, q16, q025)

# ---------------------------- config ------------------------------------------
CURVE_MAIN <- "q50"
CURVES_SENS <- c("q16", "q025")
CURVES_ALL  <- c(CURVE_MAIN, CURVES_SENS)

CURVE_LABS <- c(q50 = "Median", q16 = "Lower tail (P16)", q025 = "Lower tail (P2.5)")
CURVE_COLS <- c(q50 = "#0072B2", q16 = "grey40", q025 = "grey40")
CURVE_LTY  <- c(q50 = "solid",   q16 = "longdash", q025 = "dotted")

# ---------------------------- data (points + LOESS preds) ---------------------
pm_pts_all <- gomp_params |>
  dplyr::filter(group == "Mammals", fit_ok, curve %in% CURVES_ALL) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    mass_g = as.numeric(mass_g),
    curve  = factor(as.character(curve), levels = CURVES_ALL),
    alpha  = as.numeric(alpha),
    beta   = as.numeric(beta)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(mass_g), mass_g > 0)

# Long table built from the already-computed loess_pred grid:
# columns: mass_g, mid/lo/hi, curve, param ("alpha"/"beta")
pred_src <- loess_pred |>
  dplyr::filter(group == "Mammals", curve %in% CURVES_ALL) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    mass_g    = as.numeric(mass_g),
    curve     = factor(as.character(curve), levels = CURVES_ALL),
    alpha_mid = as.numeric(alpha_mid),
    alpha_lo  = as.numeric(alpha_lo),
    alpha_hi  = as.numeric(alpha_hi),
    beta_mid  = as.numeric(beta_mid),
    beta_lo   = as.numeric(beta_lo),
    beta_hi   = as.numeric(beta_hi)
  )

loess_pred_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  pred_src |>
    dplyr::transmute(mass_g, curve, mid = alpha_mid, lo = alpha_lo, hi = alpha_hi, param = "alpha"),
  pred_src |>
    dplyr::transmute(mass_g, curve, mid = beta_mid,  lo = beta_lo,  hi = beta_hi,  param = "beta")
)

# ---------------------------- plot helper ------------------------------------
plot_loess_param <- function(param = c("alpha", "beta"),
                             curves_to_plot,
                             show_x = TRUE,
                             show_y = TRUE,
                             show_legend = FALSE) {
  param <- match.arg(param)
  curves_to_plot <- intersect(CURVES_ALL, curves_to_plot)

  pred <- loess_pred_all |>
    dplyr::filter(param == !!param, curve %in% curves_to_plot)

  pts <- pm_pts_all |>
    dplyr::filter(curve %in% curves_to_plot)

  # Separate main curve for visual emphasis
  pred_main <- pred |> dplyr::filter(curve == CURVE_MAIN)
  pred_sens <- pred |> dplyr::filter(curve != CURVE_MAIN)
  pts_main  <- pts  |> dplyr::filter(curve == CURVE_MAIN)
  pts_sens  <- pts  |> dplyr::filter(curve != CURVE_MAIN)

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    # CI ribbon for the main curve only
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      data = pred_main,
      ggplot2::aes(x = mass_g, ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
      fill = CURVE_COLS[[CURVE_MAIN]],
      alpha = 0.14,
      colour = NA
    ) +
    # Points (behind lines)
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = pts_sens,
      ggplot2::aes(x = mass_g, y = .data[[param]], color = curve),
      shape = 16, size = 1.6, alpha = 0.75,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = pts_main,
      ggplot2::aes(x = mass_g, y = .data[[param]], color = curve),
      shape = 16, size = 2.0, alpha = 0.90,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # Lines (on top)
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = pred_sens,
      ggplot2::aes(x = mass_g, y = mid, color = curve, linetype = curve),
      linewidth = 0.85, alpha = 0.80, lineend = "round"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = pred_main,
      ggplot2::aes(x = mass_g, y = mid, color = curve, linetype = curve),
      linewidth = 1.20, alpha = 1.00, lineend = "round"
    ) +
    # Scales + labels
    ggplot2::scale_x_log10(
      breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 4),
      labels = fmt_mass_axis,
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.03))
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = CURVE_COLS,
      breaks = curves_to_plot,
      labels = CURVE_LABS[curves_to_plot],
      name   = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(
      values = CURVE_LTY,
      breaks = curves_to_plot,
      labels = CURVE_LABS[curves_to_plot],
      name   = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        nrow = 1,
        byrow = TRUE,
        keywidth = grid::unit(2.45, "lines"),
        keyheight = grid::unit(0.75, "lines"),
        override.aes = list(shape = NA, linewidth = 1.15)
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = if (isTRUE(show_x)) "Body mass" else NULL,
      y = if (isTRUE(show_y)) if (param == "alpha") expression(alpha) else expression(beta) else NULL
    ) +
    theme_pub(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position  = if (isTRUE(show_legend)) "bottom" else "none",
      legend.text      = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, color = "grey15", margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 14)),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(2.45, "lines"),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.8, "lines"),
      legend.box.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 4)
    )

  # Parameter-specific y-scale
  if (param == "alpha") {
    p + ggplot2::scale_y_log10(
      breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 4),
      labels = scales::label_number(),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
    )
  } else {
    p + ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
      labels = scales::label_number(),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
    )
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Median + lower-tail curves (legend extracted once)
# =============================================================================
pB_alpha <- plot_loess_param("alpha", CURVES_ALL, show_legend = FALSE)

pB_beta_leg <- plot_loess_param("beta", CURVES_ALL, show_legend = TRUE)
legend_B <- cowplot::get_legend(pB_beta_leg)
pB_beta  <- pB_beta_leg + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")

row_B <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  pB_alpha, pB_beta,
  nrow = 1,
  labels = c("(a)", "(b)"),
  label_fontface = "bold",
  label_size = 13,
  align = "hv",
  axis  = "tb"
)

fig_S3_loess_q50_q16_q025 <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  row_B, legend_B,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.16)
)

fig_S3_loess_q50_q16_q025
save_manuscript_figure(fig_S3_loess_q50_q16_q025, "mammal_loess")
```


```{r}
## ---- birds_combo_palette_match_ternary_sigma_and_plot_2x3 --------------------
## Goal: color each diet combo line by the same sigma_r value implied by the
## ternary sigma diagram. Compute predicted log10(sigma_r) at 108 g.
## then map those values through the SAME "plasma" gradient used in Fig 2(b),
## and reuse those colors for the LOESS Gompertz parameter curves.

CURVES_BIRDS <- CURVES
REF_MASS_G   <- 108  # must match Figure 2(b): mass_for_map_g

# Files produced by 1_rm_sigma_models.Rmd (your script above)
PATH_ILR_COMBOS <- "Data/Clean/bird_ilr_combo_coords.csv"
PATH_POST_SIGMA <- "Data/Clean/post_bird_sigma_ilr_coefs.csv"

# ---- 1) Build a combo -> predicted log10(sigma_r) table -----------------------

# (a) ILR coordinates for the simulated bird diet combinations (combo, ilr1, ilr2)
ilr_design <- readr::read_csv(PATH_ILR_COMBOS, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    combo = as.character(combo),
    ilr1  = as.numeric(ilr1),
    ilr2  = as.numeric(ilr2)
  )

# Use posterior medians for the bird sigma_r ~ logM + ilr1 + ilr2 model.
draws_sigma <- readr::read_csv(
  PATH_POST_SIGMA,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_select = dplyr::all_of(c("alpha", "beta_logM", "beta_ilr1", "beta_ilr2"))
)

coef_med <- list(
  alpha     = stats::median(draws_sigma$alpha,     na.rm = TRUE),
  beta_logM = stats::median(draws_sigma$beta_logM, na.rm = TRUE),
  beta_ilr1 = stats::median(draws_sigma$beta_ilr1, na.rm = TRUE),
  beta_ilr2 = stats::median(draws_sigma$beta_ilr2, na.rm = TRUE)
)

combo_sigma <- ilr_design |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    logM = log10(REF_MASS_G),
    pred_logSigma = coef_med$alpha +
      coef_med$beta_logM * logM +
      coef_med$beta_ilr1 * ilr1 +
      coef_med$beta_ilr2 * ilr2
  )

# ---- 2) Match Fig 2(b) ternary color mapping, centered on an equal diet ------

# Minimal copies of the ternary helpers (no checks; same logic as 1_rm_sigma_models.Rmd)
zero_replace <- function(prop_df) {
  X <- as.data.frame(prop_df)
  if (!any(X == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) return(X)
  zCompositions::cmultRepl(X, method = "CZM", label = 0) |>
    as.data.frame()
}
to_ilr3 <- function(prop_df) {
  X <- as.data.frame(prop_df)
  X <- X / rowSums(X)
  X <- zero_replace(X)
  X <- X / rowSums(X)
  Z <- compositions::ilr(compositions::acomp(X)) |>
    as.data.frame()
  names(Z) <- c("ilr1", "ilr2")
  Z
}
simplex_grid_10pct <- function() {
  k <- 10
  g <- expand.grid(i = 0:k, j = 0:k)
  g$k <- k - g$i - g$j
  g <- g[g$k >= 0, , drop = FALSE]
  tibble::tibble(
    Diet_Inv          = g$i / k,
    Diet_AllPlants    = g$j / k,
    Diet_VertFishScav = g$k / k
  )
}

grid_prop <- simplex_grid_10pct()
grid_ilr  <- to_ilr3(grid_prop)

grid_pred <- dplyr::bind_cols(grid_prop, grid_ilr) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    logM = log10(REF_MASS_G),
    pred_logSigma = coef_med$alpha +
      coef_med$beta_logM * logM +
      coef_med$beta_ilr1 * ilr1 +
      coef_med$beta_ilr2 * ilr2
  )

equal_ilr <- data.frame(ilr1 = 0, ilr2 = 0)

equal_logSigma <- coef_med$alpha +
  coef_med$beta_logM * log10(REF_MASS_G) +
  coef_med$beta_ilr1 * equal_ilr$ilr1[1] +
  coef_med$beta_ilr2 * equal_ilr$ilr2[1]

grid_pred <- grid_pred |>
  dplyr::mutate(sigma_rel_equal = pred_logSigma - equal_logSigma)

combo_sigma <- combo_sigma |>
  dplyr::mutate(sigma_rel_equal = pred_logSigma - equal_logSigma)

sigma_rel_limits <- range(grid_pred$sigma_rel_equal, finite = TRUE)

sigma_breaks <- scales::breaks_pretty(n = 5)(sigma_rel_limits)
sigma_breaks <- sigma_breaks[
  sigma_breaks >= sigma_rel_limits[1] &
    sigma_breaks <= sigma_rel_limits[2]
]

# If any combo appears in loess_pred but not in combo_sigma, keep it in the plot
# with a neutral color value.
combo_levels <- loess_pred |>
  dplyr::filter(group == "Birds") |>
  dplyr::pull(combo) |>
  unique() |>
  sort()

missing_combos <- setdiff(combo_levels, combo_sigma$combo)
if (length(missing_combos) > 0) {
  combo_sigma <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    combo_sigma,
    tibble::tibble(
      combo = missing_combos,
      ilr1 = NA_real_,
      ilr2 = NA_real_,
      logM = log10(REF_MASS_G),
      pred_logSigma = equal_logSigma,
      sigma_rel_equal = 0
    )
  )
}

# ---- 3) 2x3 LOESS Gompertz parameter figure, using sigma-relative colors -----

curve_title <- c(q50 = "q50 (median)", q16 = "q16 (P16)", q025 = "q025 (P2.5)")

pred_wide <- loess_pred |>
  dplyr::filter(group == "Birds", curve %in% CURVES_BIRDS) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    combo  = factor(as.character(combo), levels = combo_levels),
    combo_chr = as.character(combo),
    curve  = factor(as.character(curve), levels = CURVES_BIRDS),
    mass_g = as.numeric(mass_g),
    alpha  = as.numeric(alpha_mid),
    beta   = as.numeric(beta_mid)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    combo_sigma |>
      dplyr::transmute(combo_chr = as.character(combo), sigma_rel_equal),
    by = "combo_chr"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(sigma_rel_equal = dplyr::coalesce(sigma_rel_equal, 0)) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(mass_g), mass_g > 0)

make_row_plot <- function(param = c("alpha", "beta"), show_x = TRUE, show_legend = FALSE) {
  param <- match.arg(param)

  df <- pred_wide |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      combo, curve, mass_g, sigma_rel_equal,
      y = if (param == "alpha") alpha else beta
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(y), y > 0)

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = mass_g, y = y, group = combo, color = sigma_rel_equal)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.85, alpha = 0.92, lineend = "round", na.rm = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      ~ curve, nrow = 1,
      labeller = ggplot2::as_labeller(curve_title)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_log10(
      breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 4),
      labels = fmt_mass_axis,
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_gradientn(
      colours = viridisLite::plasma(256, end = 0.98),
      limits = sigma_rel_limits,
      breaks = sigma_breaks,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = expression(Delta * log[10](sigma[r])),
      guide = if (isTRUE(show_legend)) {
        ggplot2::guide_colorbar(
          title.position = "top",
          title.hjust = 0.5,
          barwidth = grid::unit(0.46, "cm"),
          barheight = grid::unit(4.4, "cm"),
          ticks = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        "none"
      }
    ) +
    theme_pub(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.position = if (isTRUE(show_legend)) "right" else "none",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8.5),
      legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 4),
      legend.box.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 3)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = if (isTRUE(show_x)) "Body mass" else NULL,
      y = if (param == "alpha") expression(alpha) else expression(beta)
    )

  if (param == "alpha") {
    p + ggplot2::scale_y_log10(
      breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 4),
      labels = scales::label_number(),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))
    )
  } else {
    p + ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
      labels = scales::label_number(),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))
    )
  }
}

p_alpha <- make_row_plot("alpha", show_x = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_blank())

p_beta_leg <- make_row_plot("beta", show_x = TRUE, show_legend = TRUE)
legend_birds <- cowplot::get_legend(p_beta_leg)
p_beta <- p_beta_leg + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")

fig_birds_loess_2x3_sigma_colors <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    p_alpha, p_beta,
    ncol = 1,
    align = "hv",
    axis  = "tblr",
    rel_heights = c(1, 1)
  ),
  legend_birds,
  ncol = 2,
  align = "hv",
  axis  = "tblr",
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.15)
)

fig_birds_loess_2x3_sigma_colors
save_manuscript_figure(fig_birds_loess_2x3_sigma_colors, "bird_loess")
```
